readme:
# LinkedIn Profile Reactions API

List the posts a LinkedIn member has reacted to - the reaction, its timestamp, and the full post it was made on with author and engagement.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/linkedin/profile-reactions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates", "limit": 10}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. A lookup that finds nothing still succeeds and returns `found: false`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | Yes | Full URL of the LinkedIn member profile whose reactions to list, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates. |
| `limit` | integer | No | Maximum number of reactions to return. One upstream page holds 100. Default `100`. |

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, usually $0.0029 per request. A call can cost more when the first data source fails and another one answers. Failed calls are not charged. Lookups that find nothing and searches with no results are billed at their actual cost, which is often lower and can be $0.
